notes.title: Bombergrounds: Classic – Release Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hello, Bombers! 💣

We're excited to announce the upcoming release of Bombergrounds: Classic, launching on September 27, 2024! 🎉 Whether you play solo or with friends, Classic brings back the fun of old-school arena combat while pushing the intensity and strategy to new heights. Be ready for fast-paced, action-packed fun that demands both brains and reflexes!

Why You’ll Love Bombergrounds: Classic:
💥 Faster Gameplay - Intensity turned up to the max. The matches are quicker and the movement is faster, making every second a high-stakes decision.

💥 No Pay-to-Win - Everyone competes on an equal footing. Your success depends purely on skill—no gameplay advantages here!

💥 One-Hit Kills - Every move matters! Outmaneuver and outsmart your enemies in lightning-fast battles where a single hit seals your fate.

💥 New Leaderboards - Prove your worth by climbing the global leaderboards. Will you be the next top bomber? 🎖️

💥 New Progression System: Levels - Unlock exciting rewards as you progress through the game's leveling system. The higher you go, the more you can show off your skills and dedication!

💥 New Cosmetic-Only Boxes - Want to stand out from the crowd? Now you can, with cosmetic items that won’t affect gameplay. These boxes can be earned with either gems or coins - meaning you can unlock them just by playing!


Early Access Offer!
Bombergrounds: Classic will be available in Early Access for just $9.99 USD. Take advantage of this limited-time discount before the full release price of $14.99 USD. Don’t miss your chance to be one of the first to experience the action and start climbing the leaderboards!


Wishlist Now and Be First to Play! 📲

 App Store: Store Page coming soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2938020/

Join the Action and Win Prizes! 🎁

Dive into the latest Bombergrounds update with patch 1.6.1! 🚀 The Gigantic Duck Team is back with another exciting patch that includes critical bug fixes, fresh features, and reworks to enhance your Bombergrounds experience. Let's break down what's new and improved in this update!


🔄 REMAKE - Giro Ability Rework
Giro, the beloved giraffe 🦒 known for the unique ability to interact with the environment, has received a significant rework. Giro can now use its ability and consume grass anywhere on the map, regardless of whether there are grass patches. This change opens up new strategic possibilities and ensures Giro remains a versatile and fun character to play in all scenarios.

The pointer system will help guide new players to things like league progress, upgrading animals, claiming free shop items, etc.. The option to disable pointers is available in the game settings.

Climb the league and earn star quality upgrades to enhance your characters. The higher you go, the stronger you become!

notes.title: [Patch 1.1.1b] Major Balancing Patch! 😍
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 🥰

The development team have implemented several changes to improve game balance. While we understand that players may have differing opinions about these changes, we believe that they are necessary for the long-term success and sustainability of the game. We value the feedback of our community and will continue to monitor the impact of these changes.

Gameplay Balance Changes

Game Mode: Battle Royale changes
In order to enhance the frenetic and unpredictable nature of Battle Royale matches, we have made the following changes to address issues of slow or comfortable gameplay.

We have reduced the time it takes for cubes to start falling from the sides of the map to just 4 seconds after the start of the game, down from 60 seconds previously. Similarly, the sudden death feature now activates 25 seconds after the map has shrunk, rather than 40 seconds beforehand. We believe that these adjustments will bring back the excitement and thrill of this game mode, as it was intended to be.

Powerup Drop Rates
Powerups now drop at an equal chance of 20%, when a crate drops loot. Each crate has an 80% chance of dropping loot.

Powerup: Damage (20% chance of dropping)
Powerup: Speed (20% chance of dropping)
Powerup: Health (20% chance of dropping)

Once a powerup drops, there is a 20% chance of it becoming a Golden Powerup, which raises the quality of the powerup by a substantial margin.

Star Drop Rates
We have made adjustments to the star system in order to address imbalances that were causing players to consistently reach Star Power 3 too quickly. With these changes, we hope to make the process of achieving Star Power 3 more enjoyable and rewarding.

Crates will now drop a minimum of 2 stars and a maximum of 3 stars, as long as they contain loot.
Event Discovery

We have adjusted the “new event” bomb reward up to 2 Bombs, up from previous 1 Bomb per Event Discovery.

In response to player feedback regarding the overpowered state of tank melee damage, we have made the following adjustments to the animals stats. notes.title: Bombergrounds: Reborn – Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Great news, Bombergrounds fans! The latest patch is here (1.1.1) and it's packed with juicy fixes and improvements to make your bomb-blasting experience even better. Here's what's new:

- We've fixed the pesky bug where your profile stats would show old information. Now, you can accurately track your kills, wins, and other stats in real time.

- We've also squashed some frustrating glitches with the game's sound effects. No more weird buzzing or skipping sounds when you're trying to focus on the action.

- We've addressed the issue where players would get stuck in custom games when someone else left. Now, you can enjoy uninterrupted bombing fun with your friends.

- Speaking of friends, we've fixed a bug where characters would get stuck in mid-air when using certain abilities. No more floating bombs or weird physics – just smooth, grounded gameplay.

- We've also fixed some ability-related issues with the Rey and Iggy characters. Rey's bomb-throwing skills are back to their full potential, and Iggy's annoying habit of jumping around has been toned down.

- The Gruff ability was causing some players to get stuck in walls or other obstacles. We've fixed this bug, so you can enjoy the full range of Gruff's explosive abilities without any unwanted side effects.

- We've also made some adjustments to the Hamsto and Hoppy abilities. Hamsto's targeting will now behave as intended, and Hoppy's ability cooldown will reset correctly even if you only use it once.

- Last but not least, we've fixed a bug where bombs would appear in one place but explode in another. This was a strange and confusing bug, but it's gone now – bombs will always behave as expected.

Thanks for playing Bombergrounds and for your patience while we worked on these fixes. If you encounter any bugs, please report them in the #bug-reports on our Discord (discord.gg/bombergrounds) server. We hope you enjoy the improved gameplay experience!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.4 – Season 3: Sudden Death, Shield/Bat changes & much more
notes.notes:
Hello ducklings,

Ahh! It has been a while since we released the last patch. The number for this patch have thus skipped a number all the way up to 0.9.4. 🙂 During this patch our focus was mainly targeted towards adding some well-needed gameplay changes. We have now added the long-wanted feature of Sudden Death, refined how Shields and Bat-hits works… oh and… we upgraded all of the Mega Bombs to level 3 by default!

Get ready for some real hectic end-game battles in Bombergrounds: Battle Royale this autumn by watching the promotional patch video below

[previewyoutube=zMzOtMyirD8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Full Patch Notes
These are the changes in patch 0.9.4 of Bombergrounds: Battle Royale.

New features


 New Major Feature: Battle Pass – Season 3 – The Autumn Season!
 New Major Feature: Sudden Death! (bombs fall from the sky at the end of the game)
 New Cosmetics: New Characters – The Goat & Panda has arrived to the battle field!
 New Cosmetics: New Skins – Mad Scientist (Mythic), Racing Driver, Police Officer and Movie Watcher has been added to the Season 3 Battle Pass.
 New Cosmetics: New Faces – Despondent & Confident.
 New Minor Feature: News-section – you’ll find a link to our news posts in the game.
 New Minor Feature: See your friends & foes Battle Pass progress in their character profile.
 New Region: Asia Pacific (Tokyo)


Gameplay changes


 Improvement: Stun invulnerability – players are immune to stuns for a short duration after being stunned.
 Improvement: Shields break from bat hits – shields now break when hit by a bat.
 Improvement: Shields now block fully charged bat hits – a fully charged bat hit no longer kills the player if they have a shield.
 Improvement: Mega Bombs bonanza! – mega bombs are now always level 3 when picked up.
 Bugfix: Players can no longer use max-charged hits at 85% charge-up.
 Bugfix: Players could push a bomb one tile further sometimes, without charigng up their hit. This has been resolved.
 Bugfix: The kill leader effect now no longer gets stuck on the ground if the kill leader leaves the game.
 Bugfix: It is no longer possible to push a bomb into a wall, and then switch sides and bat it from the inside of that wall object.


Client changes


 Performance: Optimized performance for a better in-game experience, especially relating to sounds in the game.
 Visual Effect: Invulnerability darkening effect (after being stunned)
 Visual Effect: Shield static effect (when broken)
 Improvement: Sound effects volumes have been adjusted to be normalized.
 Improvement: Players can no longer press enter while in spectate mode to pull up the chat input.
 Improvement: We’ve adjusted the color and width of the Region selector scrollbar.
 Improvement: The emoji system now displays emojis in a little better quality. (… don’t tell anyone but… we have a surprise for emoji lovers coming up in the next patch.. psst!)
 Improvement: Bombs that are dropped to the map by the server now has “!”-warning signs on them.
 Improvement: A small screen shake effect has been added when hitting and when receiving a shield hit from another player.
 Bugfix: The walk animation is now playing properly while in bat-charging.
 Bugfix: The “Honey Dipper” weapon is now displaying properly and the clipping bug has been resolved.
 Bugfix: The Battle Pass item list has been fixed to display all items properly, even after closing or opening the information tab.
 Bugfix: Sending a Friend invite now properly informs you what happened after sending the invite.
 Bugfix: The “counting”-sound when receiving experience in the Score Screen now works properly.
 Bugfix: The “disable chat” in options should now always work properly.
 Bugfix: We’ve added “click”-sounds to the buttons: News, Follow Us, Emoji, Settings wheel, Exit button.
 Bugfix: Picking up stars after level 3 now properly plays a star pickup sound.
 Bugfix: The client now correctly states who killed you in the game (“Eliminated by X”).


Server changes


 Bugfix: We’ve resolved a matchmaking bug where a game started but nobody got into the game server.
 Bugfix: We’ve resolved several “your connection has been lost” and stability issues in this patch. We hope that the stability of the game will feel smoother going forward!
 Improvement: Hateful & bad words should now be properly filtered away in account names & chat.


Content Creator changes

No content creator changes this patch.

notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Rejoice! The first big patch is here – version 0.8.6.

This patch mostly fixes bugs and problems with the game that you have reported during the past two weeks of play. We take these bugs seriously and we want to fix them before adding more content. We will address new content in the next patch.

Firstly, we want to thank everyone that has reported bugs in our Discord channel. Secondly, we’ve had a few setbacks that have delayed this patch that have been outside of our control, so we want to thank you deeply for supporting us and our development. 🙂



Patch delivery & details
Details
Previous live version: 0.8.3 (all platforms)
Updates to: 0.8.6 (all platforms)

Delivery date/time
We are going to patch immediately.

Downtime expected
30 minutes to 1 hour.

Patch notes
Region changes

Added region – SEA (Singapore)
Added region – South America (Sao Paolo)
Queue – The region you are queueing towards is now shown in the queueing status text.
Balance changes

Balance – Minimum amount of stars that can drop from a dead player is raised to 3.
Balance – Maximum distance to pick up an item has been lowered and stabilized a bit.
Game Server changes

Bugfix – Bombs falling into water no longer disappears on the client but explodes on the server (invisible bombs bug)
Bugfix – Bombs falling into wall objects no longer happens (invisible bombs bug)
Bugfix – Double items from crates is now resolved. It should now give the appropriate amount of items
Bugfix – Coins not being received after lv 50
Bugfix – Being able to easily clip through wall blocks that are placed in a certain manner
Stability – Fixed disconnect loop when reconnecting bug
Stability – Added dynamic region support
Client changes

Performance – Lowered texture resolution a bit more
Performance – Lowered resolution for low/mid settings, your game should look worse in these settings but perform better FPS wise.
Performance – Recent friends list is now overwritten every time a new game ends, so it does not store all players in a huge list.
Performance – Added a FPS/Latency setting to be able to diagnose ping/fps while playing.
Stability – The “game starting…” bug but a game never stars, should be fixed.
Controls – Added a “fixed joystick” setting for mobile
Controls – Added keybind options for PC/Mac
Login – Auto-log in with Gigantic Duck ID: It is now possible to log in automatically after using a Gigantic Duck ID. It will be saved for as long as you don’t log into another account (like a guest account or another Gigantic Duck ID).
Login – You can now click “log in with Gigantic Duck ID” instead of having to create a new username.
UI – Some Lobby UI parts were showing while in-game.
UI – Opening chests should now update the status of the item you got accordingly (the checkmark).
UI – Fixed profile stats not scaling properly
UI – Fixed profile “time played” not showing the correct time
UI – Fixed profile screen player name scaling bug
UI – Fixed “logging in” status when picking a wrong or unavailable username on registration (visual bug)
UI – Extended hit area for Exit & Settings buttons
UI – Added discord and twitter buttons
UI – Fixed gameoverscreen stats bug (“11:11, 11, level 50”)
UI – Fixed “link account” button not animating sometimes
UI – Added text feedback about current queue region
UI – Fixed steam shop page displaying wrong currency in some countries
UI – Updated region settings dropdown
UI – Updated resolution settings to use users screen (Desktop)
Graphics – Fixed Picnic Bear helmet texture
Content Creator changes

1. Hide chat
2. Hide names
